additional_info.subject: Sicharge D - OCPP not working properly when offline
additional_info.body:
Hi there, we need your help on the following topic
Serial Number:
170000997 -
https://configuration.sicharge.technology/chargers/qbJssk/detail
Testing Time
: 11:20 – 12:00 Argentinian Time (GMT-3)
We’ve been doing some tests on a Sicharge D and have the following outcome.
First Scenario
{"key":"LocalAuthListEnabled","value":"true","readonly":false},
{"key":"LocalAuthListMaxLength","value":"100","readonly":true},
{"key":"LocalAuthorizeOffline","value":"true","readonly":false},
{"key":"LocalPreAuthorize","value":"false","readonly":false},
{"key":"AuthorizationCacheEnabled","value":"false","readonly":false},
First attempt, charging online. Works fine
We set the charger as if it lost connection to OCPP, it worked correctly when offline (recognizing the RFID’s saved locally)
When we connected again the OCPP, the problem started.
Because the charger started charging without asking for authorization to the OCPP, so the backed closed the charging session.
Second Scenario
{"key":"LocalAuthListEnabled","value":"
false
","readonly":false},
{"key":"LocalAuthListMaxLength","value":"100","readonly":true},
{"key":"LocalAuthorizeOffline","value":"true","readonly":false},
{"key":"LocalPreAuthorize","value":"false","readonly":false},
{"key":"AuthorizationCacheEnabled","value":"false","readonly":false},
With OCPP Online, it worked just fine
With OCPP Offline, it didn’t work because the LocalAuthListEnabled is set to false.
Some Logs of the errors
2024-07-25T14:40:14.661619+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/20f765c96437[703]: OCPP: Send command: StopTransaction (83e92af1-5b20-4170-b7f8-10cdb23f377c) - {"meterStop":303,"timestamp":"2024-07-25T14:37:03.463Z","transactionData":[{"timestamp":"2024-07-25T14:37:03.463Z","sampledValue":[{"value":"303","location":"Outlet","unit":"Wh","context":"Transaction.End","measurand":"Energy.Active.Import.Register"},{"value":"80","location":"EV","unit":"Percent","measurand":"SoC"}]}],"reason":"Local","idTag":"045742CF","transactionId":0}
2024-07-25T14:41:45.904680+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/20f765c96437[703]: OCPP: Send command: StatusNotification (1af4c893-86c2-4684-ae15-62a2fc839290) - {"connectorId":0,"errorCode":"
LocalListConflict"
,"status":"Available"}
Third Scenario
{"key":"LocalAuthListEnabled","value":"false","readonly":false},
{"key":"LocalAuthListMaxLength","value":"100","readonly":true},
{"key":"LocalAuthorizeOffline","value":"true","readonly":false},
{"key":"LocalPreAuthorize","value":"false","readonly":false}
{"key":"AuthorizationCacheEnabled","value":"
true
","readonly":false},
First attempt – Online. Worked just fine
Second attempt – Offline. Worked just fine
Third attempt – Online again. Works fine again.
Shouldn’t It work when we have the first scenario?
Best regards

additional_info.body:
Hi there,
It is not integrated, however, the behavior seems quite odd.
Are we sure that the problem is in the OCPP and not with the charger behaviour?
Best regards.

additional_info.subject: L2 handover
additional_info.body: OCPP not integrated. Please ask the customer to take up this issue with the integration team. No charge events were found without authorization, so customer's claim regarding that the charger when online started without authorization cannot be verified.
